title: Sort C_GetSlotList output alphabetically by keystore_path
description: Currently C_GetSlotList returns slots in insertion order (whichever .p11k file was scanned first). Sort the output array by keystore_path so the mapping from slot ID to file is deterministic and alphabetical. Soft token (slot 0) always first. Hardware USB tokens (PIV/OpenPGP) next by VID/PID. Keystore-backed slots last, sorted by keystore_path. Implementation: collect slot IDs, qsort with comparator.
